title: powerops drift snapshot file
description: A file written by 'powerops drift --save <dir>': what was read of one solution in one environment, for a later offline drift run. It holds the environment's friendly name and the SHA-256 of each environment variable's current value, never the value, an environment id or URL, a connection id or a user name. A hash hides a value from a reader, not from someone who guesses short or known values, so keep these files in private folders and private CI artifacts. Version 2 also holds the definition names of components of type 10000 and above and the schema names of the solution's agents and agent components; version-1 files still load, and a snapshot without names is still written as version 1.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the snapshot file format. 2 adds name and schemaName on components and the agents list; a snapshot read without names (the solution is not installed, or a deploy target read) is written as version 1. It moves only when this format changes, not with the report outputs' schemaVersion.

layersRead.description: False only when the layer read was dropped for a managed solution; true when layers were read or no read was needed.

components.description: Solution components, sorted by type, then id.

unmanagedLayer.description: Null when layers were not read or the solution is unmanaged.

name.description: Version 2. The component definition's primaryentityname, for a type of 10000 or above that the read named; else null.

schemaName.description: Version 2. The schema name of an agent (name bot) or agent component (name botcomponent) the read returned; else null.

variables.description: Environment variables, sorted by schema name.

valueHash.description: SHA-256 of the current value's UTF-8 bytes (\r\n turned into \n), lowercase hex; null when there is no current value.

references.description: Connection references, sorted by logical name.

id.description: The connectionreferenceid, a solution component id.

bound.description: Whether a connection is set. The connection id itself is never stored.

id.description: The workflowid, the same across imports.

agents.description: Version 2. The solution's agents (bot rows), sorted by schema name; empty when it holds none.

publishedOn.description: Whether publishedon is set; the date itself is not stored.
